attributes.board_name: State Board of Social Workers, Marriage and Family Therapists and Professional Counselors

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved providers incl. preapproved (49 Pa. Code §49.36): CSWE-accredited programs, ASWB and ASWB ACE, accredited colleges/universities, COAMFTE and CACREP programs, NASW, CSWA, NBCC, CRCC, APA, ANCC, AAMFT, ACA, AMHCA and others; other courses only with prior Board approval (§49.36a)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensees first licensed during the current biennium are exempt from the 30 hours at the first renewal, except the 2 hours of child abuse recognition and reporting training (2025 Renewal Guide). Associate licensees (LAPC/LAMFT): first renewal needs only 1 h suicide prevention + 2 h child abuse.
rules.carryover: Not allowed (excess clock hours may not be carried over).
rules.audit_note: Signed certification at renewal; random audits. Keep certificates at least 4 years (2025 Renewal Guide). Child abuse course completion is reported electronically by the approved provider.

topics.who: All licensees; DHS/Bureau-approved provider (Act 31); 3 hours required once for initial licensure
All licensees: assessment, treatment and management of suicide risks (Act 74 of 2016); does not count toward ethics

rules.notes: Biennium runs March 1 of an odd year to Feb 28 of the next odd year. Home study: rule text caps it at 20 hours, but a Board notice of 11/19/2019 permits all 30 hours online (no live requirement). One board licenses SW, MFT and LPC.
